name: Anime Adventures
tagline: Working Anime Adventures codes for free gems, gold and summon boosts.
description: Anime Adventures is a Roblox tower-defense game where players summon anime-inspired heroes to fight off waves of enemies. Codes are released after major updates and at follower milestones, granting free gems (premium currency), gold and short XP boosts. Stack codes before opening a banner to maximise your summons. Note: the game's update cadence has slowed in 2026, so new codes are less frequent than during the game's 2023-2024 peak.

redeemSteps.title: Launch Anime Adventures
redeemSteps.detail: Open Roblox and start an Anime Adventures session — any lobby works.

redeemSteps.title: Open the settings menu
redeemSteps.detail: Tap the gear icon at the bottom of the screen to open the settings panel.

redeemSteps.title: Find the Code section
redeemSteps.detail: Scroll to the Twitter Codes section inside the settings menu.

redeemSteps.title: Enter the code
redeemSteps.detail: Paste the code exactly as shown — Anime Adventures codes are case-sensitive.

redeemSteps.title: Hit Redeem
redeemSteps.detail: Working codes deliver rewards instantly to your inventory.

faq.question: Are Anime Adventures codes case-sensitive?
faq.answer: Yes. Type or paste the code exactly as listed — uppercase and lowercase letters matter.

faq.question: How often do new codes drop?
faq.answer: During the game's active development (2023–2024) codes appeared with every major update. The release cadence has slowed in 2026, so check back monthly rather than weekly.

faq.question: What's the best time to redeem boost codes?
faq.answer: Save 2x XP and 2x Gems boosts until right before a banner refresh or a long farming session to get the most value.

faq.question: Why do some codes require a minimum level?
faq.answer: A handful of older codes (e.g. ASSASSIN-style codes) needed account level 20 or 50 before they would redeem. Level requirements are noted in each code's description where applicable.

codes.notes: Released around April 1 — still redeemable as of mid-May 2026.
